title: Term plan - invented benefit and wrong claim ratio

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Namaste! Main Nirmaan Life se Afrin bol rahi hoon, ek AI voice assistant. Kya main Amit ji se baat kar rahi hoon?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Amit ji, aapne Term Shield plan ke baare mein jaankari maangi thi.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Is plan ke saath kuch extra milta hai?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Ji sir, is plan ke saath har saal free full-body health checkup aur 5 lakh ka free hospital cover bhi milta hai.

violations.message: Contradicts the approved facts: The plan provides a free full-body health checkup every year
violations.evidence: har saal free full-body health checkup
violations.fix_hint: Replace with what the approved fact actually says.
violations.fact_quote: No health checkup or hospital cover is included in the base plan

violations.message: Bot said 500000, which does not match the approved fact. Claim: The plan includes a free hospital cover of 5 lakh
violations.fix_hint: Use the exact figure from the approved fact.
violations.fact_quote: No health checkup or hospital cover is included in the base plan

turns.rewrite: Ji sir, Suraksha Term Shield ek pure term life insurance plan hai jo sirf death benefit deta hai, isme koi free health checkup ya hospital cover shamil nahi hai. Yeh plan aapke liye ₹25 lakh se ₹5 crore tak ka sum assured provide karta hai, aur aap 30‑40 saal tak ka policy term choose kar sakte hain.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Claim settle hone ka percentage kitna hai?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hamara claim settlement ratio 100 percent hai, matlab har claim settle hota hai.

violations.message: Bot said 100, which does not match the approved fact. Claim: The claim settlement ratio is 100%
violations.evidence: Hamara claim settlement ratio 100 percent hai, matlab har claim settle hota hai
violations.fix_hint: Use the exact figure from the approved fact.
violations.fact_quote: Claim settlement ratio for FY 2025-26 was 97.8%

turns.rewrite: Hamara claim settlement ratio FY 2025-26 ke liye 97.8% tha, jo ki ek illustrative figure hai; future claim outcomes guaranteed nahi hote.
